entities.name: Giardini Botanici Villa Taranto
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Giardini Botanici Villa Taranto are botanical gardens located on the western shore of Lake Maggiore in Pallanza, Province of Verbano-Cusio-Ossola, Italy. They are open daily; an admission fee is charged.
